dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, no... It's good that they stopped, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Hmm... But it's all too sudden. I came up with so many contingency plans. Are we not going to get the chance to any of them?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: My contingencies included ways to scatter the people in the wild to avoid the storms, teach them how to survive...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: ...We were going to teach them to set up basic camps, do pest control, avoid beasts and monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, never mind. Rather than take our chances out there, better to remain safe within these walls.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. Some of our investigating adventurers have informed me that there are monsters congregating in the Whispering Woods.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Almost everyone is out investigating, and I must remain here to command them.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Traveler, can I count on you to clear those monsters out?
